transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this coverage huddle to order. As you know, the Advanced Chemistry teacher will be absent for three consecutive school days next month, and I need to approve both the coverage roster and the instructional plan before anything gets posted to staff. The draft we have in front of us uses one substitute, regular classroom activities, and the standard make-up-work process. Before I review and sign off on this, I need to hear from each of you — department chair, HR coordinator, nurse, and counselor — on any relevant updates that might affect this plan. Let's go around the room.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue. My department calendar shows that the class's graded chemistry lab practical is scheduled for the second day of the absence, and it cannot be replaced by a worksheet. Department policy requires a chemistry-certified teacher to supervise it. I entered the practical in the department calendar this week, but I had not yet forwarded the calendar note to Ms. Morgan, so she wouldn't have seen it when the draft plan was put together.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an important update from HR. I verified in the substitute credential and availability system that Dr. Lena Park is the only available substitute with a current chemistry certificate, and she is available for all three absence days. However, the staffing roster has not yet been updated with that verification, so it wouldn't have appeared in the draft plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a health and safety concern. A student in this Advanced Chemistry class has an active seizure action plan that requires an adult trained in seizure response to remain in the classroom during laboratory activities. I confirmed both the seizure action plan and Dr. Lena Park's seizure response training record this week — her training is current — but I have not yet attached either record to the coverage request. This is directly relevant given that Mr. Singh just mentioned a lab practical is scheduled during the absence, and Ms. Bell has identified Dr. Park as the available substitute.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a student support concern to raise. One student in this Advanced Chemistry class is the primary after-school caregiver for a younger sibling and cannot use the school's online make-up portal during these three absence days. I confirmed in a family meeting that this student needs a printed make-up packet available before the absence begins. I recorded the request in my counseling file, but I have not yet sent it to the classroom teacher, so it would not have been reflected in the draft plan's standard make-up-work process.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.make_up_materials: Printed make-up packet prepared before absence begins, in addition to standard make-up-work process
